title: 1998 California 500 Official Race Program NASCAR Winston Cup California Speedway
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Vintage Sports Memorabilia:Publications:Programs:Racing
descriptionText:
Second Annual California 500 presented by NAPA - Official Race Program, California Speedway (Fontana), Sunday May 3, 1998. NASCAR Winston Cup Series, with the NASCAR 50th Anniversary logo, Kenwood Pole Day and Auto Club 300 (Busch Series) companion events. Gold cover with the race-action painting; back cover carries the "Fast Track to the Inland Empire" Inland Empire Economic Partnership ad. Mark Martin won the race.

Condition: Pre-owned, excellent - glossy cover bright with only light corner and edge wear, spine tight, pages clean. Please review the photos - they are of the actual program you will receive.
